//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Name Tag Tweaks -> Config

Enable Name Tag Tweaks.//: Whether Name Tag Tweaks is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

droppedNameTagbyEntityKeepsNameValue.//: If enabled, any name tag that drops on an entity's death will keep its named value.

enableNameTagCommand.//: If enabled, adds the /nametag <name> command. Used to change the name value without an anvil.

nameTagCommandReplaceUnderscoresWithSpac.//: If enabled, replaces underscores with spaces when using the /nametag command.
